basic_info.description: Super Price Reduction, Come See. Welcome to this modern living corner lot home in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods  Ingleside Heights. This spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home plus a bonus bedroom/office has been thoughtfully renovated and is move-in ready! Newly refinished hardwood floors, updated kitchen with refinished cabinets, stainless steel appliances and a stylish wet bar-perfect for entertaining! Spacious, low-maintenance backyard for relaxation and outdoor enjoyment. Stunning ocean and mountain views, including the picturesque Harding Golf Course. Overlooks the newly rebuilt Merced Heights playground-a fantastic space for families and pets. Unbeatable convenience, steps away from Stonestown Galleria, H-Mart, SF State, and Lick-Wilmerding High School. Easy access to public transportation, Highway 280, and top-rated schools, including the Mandarin Immersion program at Jose Ortega Elementary. Whether you're looking for a primary residence or a rental investment, 186 Byxbee St is a must-see!
